thread.title: Stocks open higher after solid Apple earnings, ADP data

author: MarketWatch
title: Stocks open higher after solid Apple earnings, ADP data
text:
Published: Aug 1, 2018 9:32 a.m. ET Share MarketWatch
U.S. stock-market indexes opened higher on Wednesday as upbeat results from Apple Inc and strong labor-market data supported positive sentiment. Companies in the private sector added 219,000 new employees to their payrolls in July. Still, gains were limited as investors continued to grapple with uncertainty surrounding tariff disputes. The S&P 500 SPX, -0.12% was 5 points, or 0.2%, higher to 2,820. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.24% opened 7 points, or less than 0.1%, higher to 25,420. The Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.29% advanced 30 points, or, 0.4%, to 7,701 at the open. Among the biggest gainers on the S&P 500, shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +5.44% rallied 4% after the company's upbeat earnings.
